findings.title: Proof six skips v6 acts and interventions when both accounting fields are absent
findings.retires: Closes the claim that every sealed v6 statement has its acts and interventions recomputed and compared by proof six.
findings.severity: Blocking when a statement declares attestation/v6, omits both time and cost, and carries false acts or interventions; the early return makes proof six hold it without checking either list.

findings.title: The v6 schema accepts intervention classes the producer can never emit
findings.retires: Closes the v6 schema's unenforced claim that intervention rows are exactly amend, launch, or transport rows from item_ledger.
findings.severity: Blocking when schema validation is used as the contract boundary and an intervention carries any non-empty class other than amend, launch, or transport; harmless while every statement comes only from the current producer and is rechecked by doctor.
